To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a series of spiro-oxindolopyrolidines fused N-styrenylpiperidone heterocylic hybrids have been synthesized by a domino multiconponent protocol that involves a one-pot three-component 1,3 dipolar cycloadditon and concomitant enammine reactions performed in an in-expensive ionic liquid, and the compounds thus synthesized were evaluated against U-937 cells.
a series of spirocyclic compounds has been synthesized via domino multicomponents reactions.
we have designed, synthesized and evaluated a series of spiro-oxindolopyrolidines fused N-styrlpiperidone hetero cyclic hybrids as potential cytotoxic agents.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel, simple, rapid, environmentally friendly, and efficient one-pot three-component domino reaction that can be performed in an inexpensive and reusable ionic liquid.
the design and synthesis of novel spirooxindole derivatives as potential anticancer agents and the study of their cytotoxic effects on human U-937 tumor cell line.
the synthesis of novel complex heterocyclic hybrids, which have been evaluated for their anticancer properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
compounds 5i, 5m and 5n could be potential candidates for the treatment of cancer.
the synthesized compounds 5a-m could be regarded as potential lead compounds for anticancer drug development.
the spirooxindole-pyrrolidine heterocyclic hybrids are promising scaffolds with potential anticancer properties.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the synthesized compounds are promising anticancer agents and can be further developed into new anticancer agents.
we have developed a simple, efficient and environmentally benign protocol for the synthesis of a series of spiroheterocycles via one-pot three-component reactions.
a series of spirocyclic heterocycles were prepared via a domino reaction and evaluated as potential anticancer agents.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the spirocyclic heterocyclic compounds 5a and 5i, which were synthesized in a single step, showed the best cytotoxic activity.
the spirooxindole-piperidone hetero-cyclic system has been successfully used to synthesize a series of complex spirodispiropyrrolidine derivatives.
the ionic liquid can be considered as an excellent solvent for the synthesis of spirooxidoles, as well as an excellent reaction medium for the evaluation of their biological properties.
